what_happened: During the Phase 6B QA screenshot run, the emulator stopped responding: adb shell and the emulator console timed out, adb reported the device offline, and qemu-system-x86_64 (PID 27812) used 0 CPU seconds over 10 s and was reported as not responding. Host free memory was 736 MB of 16 GB at the time.
steps: Restarted the host adb server (no device effect).
Stopped the idle Gradle and Kotlin build daemons to free host memory (free memory rose to 3,102 MB). The emulator did not recover.
Stopped the hung emulator process and started the same AVD with its original flags: -no-snapshot-load -no-snapshot-save (cold boot from the current disk, no snapshot rollback).
No app data was cleared, uninstalled, reseeded or migrated. No package was installed into in.jansetu.app.
result: All four protected preview hashes are identical before the hang and after the restart. Packages present after restart: in.jansetu.app, in.jansetu.app.qa, in.jansetu.app.qa.test, in.jansetu.app.test.
note: The preview app's boot receiver reconciles reminder alarms on BOOT_COMPLETED; it did not change the alarm registry hash.
